title.it: Gestione automatica Bluetooth, supporto BLE/wearable e recupero adattatore
title.en: Automatic Bluetooth management, BLE/wearable support, and adapter recovery
title.fr: Gestion automatique Bluetooth, support BLE/connectés et récupération adaptateur
title.es: Gestión automática de Bluetooth, soporte BLE/wearables y recuperación de adaptador

features.it: Supporto completo a dispositivi BLE e wearable cardio/fitbit con pairing GATT, cache vicinanze 300s e selettore persona.
features.en: Full support for BLE and fitness/heart-rate wearables with GATT pairing, 300s nearby cache, and person selector.
features.fr: Support complet des appareils BLE et montres cardio avec appairage GATT, cache de 300s et sélecteur de personne.
features.es: Soporte completo para dispositivos BLE y wearables de ritmo cardíaco con emparejamiento GATT, caché de 300s y selector de persona.

features.it: Auto-recovery dell'adattatore Bluetooth su errori HCI/busy e ciclo di scansione periodico automatico.
features.en: Bluetooth adapter auto-recovery on HCI/busy hardware errors and automatic periodic background scan cycle.
features.fr: Récupération automatique de l'adaptateur Bluetooth sur erreurs HCI/busy et cycle de scan périodique en arrière-plan.
features.es: Recuperación automática del adaptador Bluetooth ante errores HCI/busy y ciclo periódico de escaneo en segundo plano.

fixes.it: Risolto errore di pairing BLE NoInputNoOutput e scomparsa dispositivi vicini dopo la scansione.
fixes.en: Fixed BLE NoInputNoOutput pairing failure and nearby devices disappearing after scan completes.
fixes.fr: Correction de l'échec d'appairage BLE NoInputNoOutput et disparition des appareils proches après le scan.
fixes.es: Corregido el fallo de emparejamiento BLE NoInputNoOutput y la desaparición de dispositivos cercanos tras el escaneo.

fixes.it: Riallineata asserzione test_avatar_space alla modalita display portrait.
fixes.en: Realigned test_avatar_space assertion to the portrait display mode.
fixes.fr: Realignement de l assertion test_avatar_space avec le mode d affichage portrait.
fixes.es: Realineada la asercion test_avatar_space con el modo de pantalla vertical.
